name: mailopoly
description: Mailopoly: every inbox and business messaging channel you own, in your AI assistant, through one MCP connection.

plugins.name: mailopoly
plugins.description: Mailopoly gives your AI assistant every inbox you own — Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, iCloud and any IMAP mailbox — plus Slack, Teams, WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, TikTok and X with business channels on your plan, through one connection with reading, making changes and sending as separate permissions.
